test_execution.environment: Standalone SPA Vitest/JSDOM config with Vue Test Utils; selected tests mount components only, no direct DB/provider/network imports or calls observed.

architecture_observations: ClinicalRecordContextAside is a read-only props component. Parent supplies summary strings, counts, and optional patient/owner destinations; no domain service or local workflow state is inside the child.

ClinicalStepNavigator uses a named tablist, roving tabindex, selected state, arrow/Home/End navigation, and focuses the selected tab after emitting. Parent page owns active step and renders one role=tabpanel whose dynamic id and aria-labelledby match the active tab.

The aside uses sticky positioning and switches to static below 1180px; the navigator changes from four columns to two below 820px. CSS presence was inspected but no browser viewport/visual test was performed.
The keyboard component test checks selected props and emitted arrow/Home/End events, but it does not assert actual DOM focus movement, screen-reader output, or browser keyboard behavior.
The focused tests use mock props only and do not cover clinical record data loading, save/validation, authorization, route composition, or clinical API behavior.

findings_and_limits.observation: The new aside component test includes a person name and phone-shaped test value. They appear synthetic, but source provenance was not established in this review.
findings_and_limits.required_followup: Confirm synthetic provenance or substitute clearly reserved test fixtures before external publication.

candidate_actions.hold_reason: All four paths are hash-stable and reviewed, but the parent clinical record workflow is still pending; fixture provenance, browser focus/accessibility/visual QA, independent critique, and complete inventory disposition remain open.

limitations: Component tests prove only the exercised props/text/attributes/event emissions in JSDOM; they do not prove focus, assistive technology, viewport behavior, clinical API safety, or persistence.
Only two extracted components and their two tests are counted in this round; MedicalRecordsDetailPage.vue and its page test remain pending.
A small manual scan identified test fixture values shaped like contact data; no real-person claim is made, but provenance must be resolved before publication.
This is primary-operator review, not independent clinical acceptance.
